author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
@feenberg I believe the difference here is the way that the 21 year old dependent is treated. Under the [legal code](https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/2#b) filers can only claim head of household filing status if they have child dependents, [reference](https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/26/152#e). Those only include dependents under 19 years of age. 

This is causing some of the differences here
